title: Ravens Report Card, Week 2: Coming up short across the board in upset loss

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens Report Card, Week 2: Coming up short across the board in upset loss
sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens suffered an upset defeat in Week 2, falling to the New Orleans Saints at home by a score of 24-17. The Ravens led for most of the game before being outscored 15-0 in the fourth quarter and squandering an eight-point lead. It was a disappointing follow up to a resounding victory in […]
